description: This file defines the IStreamSubscriptionManager interface, which provides methods for managing stream subscriptions in Orleans, including adding, removing, and retrieving subscriptions.

classes.name: IStreamSubscriptionManager
classes.description: Interface for managing stream subscriptions, including adding, removing, and retrieving subscriptions.

methods.name: AddSubscription
methods.description: Subscribes a grain to a stream, returning the created StreamSubscription.

methods.name: RemoveSubscription
methods.description: Unsubscribes a grain from a stream based on stream provider, stream ID, and subscription ID.

methods.name: GetSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all subscriptions for a specified stream.
